text: Research your own experience; absorb what is useful, reject what is useless and add what is essentially your own.
author: Bruce Lee
visual_brief: A precise engineering schematic of a gem faceting arm and dop stick holding an unrefined mineral crystal against a flat lap wheel. Fine projection lines and angular degree callouts map out the planes being shaved away, with directional rotation arrows showing the cut while dotted lines trace the discarded rough silhouette.
alt: Engineering schematic of a lapidary tool carving precise facets into stone
